scope.supports: Universal I3(alpha*t²+beta*t⁴)=12*beta*abc(a+b+c), hence universal vanishing iff beta=0. Exact Q(zeta12) control norms (7,±4) give R_AB invariance iff B=0; no full positivity-cone classification is inferred.
